Cox proportional-hazards model for simulation data

Source: R/survival.R
cox_model.Rd

Cox proportional-hazards model for simulation data

Usage

cox_model(
  data,
  endpoint = c("stage2", "overall", "service"),
  covariates = c("scenario", "severity", "group"),
  reference_scenario = "A-S00"
)

Arguments

data

A dynasimR_data object or entity tibble. Endpoint times must be nonnegative finite observed event or censoring times; flags must be 0 (censored) or 1 (event). Missing times, flags, strata, or model covariates are rejected rather than silently dropping entities.

endpoint

See km_estimate().

covariates

Character vector. Covariates entering the Cox model. Default c("scenario","severity","group"); unavailable defaults are omitted with a warning for profile compatibility. Explicitly requested unavailable covariates are an error.

reference_scenario

Character. Reference level for the scenario factor. Default "A-S00". Use "B-S00" for Profile B.

Value

An S3 object of class dynasimR_cox with slots fit, tidy, ph_test, forest_data and params.

Examples

sim <- load_example_data()
cx <- cox_model(sim, endpoint = "stage2")
cx
#> 
#> ── dynasimR_cox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Endpoint: "stage2"

#> 3 scenarioA-S08 1.08     0.0257    2.97   0.00303     1.03    1.13  **   
#> 4 severity      0.840    0.0371   -4.70   0.00000262  0.781   0.903 ***  
#> 5 groupB        0.982    0.0206   -0.893  0.372       0.943   1.02  ns   
#> 6 groupC        1.01     0.0243    0.548  0.584       0.966   1.06  ns
